streaming.description: Publish supported replies while generating. Set false to send only complete replies.

streamingIntervalMs.description: Minimum delay in milliseconds between reply updates; the first update is immediate.

master.description: 框架 master（sandbox client id (distinct from endpoints[].owner)；AI/工具权限、endpoint 管理）。endpoints[i].master 可逐项覆盖

en.description: Framework masters (sandbox client id, distinct from endpoints[].owner; AI/tool permissions and endpoint management). endpoints[i].master can override this value.

items.description: Trusted sandbox client id (distinct from endpoints[].owner)

trusted.description: 框架 trusted 用户列表（弱于 master）。endpoints[i].trusted 可逐项追加

en.description: Framework trusted users, below master authority. endpoints[i].trusted can add users.

endpoints.description: 多账号：一个插件实例挂多个 endpoint。每项与顶层字段同构（id 必填，其余覆盖顶层）

master.description: 本 endpoint 的框架 master（sandbox client id (distinct from endpoints[].owner)）；覆盖顶层 master

en.description: Framework masters for this endpoint (sandbox client id, distinct from endpoints[].owner), overriding the top-level master list.

items.description: Trusted sandbox client id (distinct from endpoints[].owner)

trusted.description: 本 endpoint 的 trusted 列表

streaming.description: Publish supported replies while generating. Set false to send only complete replies.

streamingIntervalMs.description: Minimum delay in milliseconds between reply updates; the first update is immediate.

en.description: Multiple accounts: mount multiple endpoints in one plugin instance. Each entry uses the top-level fields; id is required and other fields override defaults.

commandPrefix.description: 命令前缀（默认 '' 无前缀，任意文本按命令匹配；如 '/' 要求 / 开头）。endpoints[i] 可逐项覆盖

en.description: Command prefix. The default empty string allows unprefixed commands; '/' requires a leading slash. Each endpoints[i] can override it.
